name: GabeCubeAura
description: Bring the Steam Machine’s 17-LED strip to life with Steam event alerts, game artwork, launch animations, custom effects, live weather, CPU/GPU monitoring, controller battery levels, and real-time screen color sync.

paragraphs: Make your Steam Machine's 17-pixel light bar useful and a little more expressive. Choose a complete lighting experience, preview it on the physical bar, then set one brightness level for every display. Optional sunset dimming uses a city you select manually, while CPU/GPU thermal protection can return complete control to Valve immediately.
Try the interactive GabeCubeAura preview before installing
If GabeCubeAura makes your Steam Machine a little better, you can support its development on Ko-fi. Thanks for your support!
features: Control shows whether GabeCubeAura or Steam is in charge. The main switch
Light bar shows the active display, its colours and available CPU/GPU
JSAUX matrix provides display status, artwork and faceplate settings.
Light bar and Faceplate displays keep the two displays independent.
Faceplate artwork contains the visual library and preparation workflow.
